title: As a researcher, I can pose a research question and get an autonomous multi-step investigation, not just a single-pass summary
As an analyst, I can start a long research job that keeps working unattended and notifies me when the result is ready
As a researcher, I can steer the depth, effort, and scope of a research run before or while it executes
As a researcher, I can see citations for every substantive claim so I can verify it against the underlying source
As a researcher, I can search scholarly literature and primary sources, not just the open web
As an analyst, I can see where sources agree and disagree instead of a single unqualified answer
As an analyst, I can get a structured report with sections, tables, and a summary that I can share with stakeholders
As a researcher, I can export results to common formats, including documents, spreadsheets, and reference-manager files
As a researcher, I can run a systematic screening and extraction workflow across many papers with consistent criteria
As a researcher, I can upload my own PDFs or corpus and have the agent research over them
As a researcher, I can set up standing searches or alerts that surface new relevant sources as they appear
As an analyst, I can share a research session or report with collaborators who can view or build on it
As a researcher, I can understand plan pricing and usage limits before committing
As a researcher, I can try the product meaningfully on a free tier or trial
